_comment: Lighthouse CI gate for the public landing page: `npm run lighthouse` starts the dev server on port 4190 (it proxies /api to the Worker, so a static dist/ directory would not do), audits three runs with Lighthouse's default mobile emulation (mid-range Android: 412x823 at 1.75x, 4x CPU slowdown, applied slow-4G/CPU throttling — `devtools`, not Lantern simulation, because Lantern shares HTTP/1.1 bandwidth evenly across in-flight same-origin requests and mis-scores self-hosted fonts by ~300 ms of LCP, see docs/audit/handoff/W2-A.md) and asserts the program budgets on the median run. Lighthouse has no field INP, so total-blocking-time (plus interactive as a warning) stands in for it. resource-summary sizes are transfer sizes: the dev server does not compress, so the 40 KB script budget is asserted on raw bytes here while the real target is 40 KB gzip — `npm run build` prints each page's gzip script weight. Needs Chrome: set CHROME_PATH if it is not on the PATH. Reports land in .lighthouseci/ (gitignore it).
